said.text: I believe the intention is correct. I just don't think the language in the bill is there yet to protect those employees and the employers. So until such time, I'll be voting no and I encourage my colleagues to do the same.

did.text: Voted No on S3460, which requires employers to give employees access to their personnel records and notice when negative information is added to them. Passed Assembly 92–49.

whyNote: The statement is from Assemblymember Durso's floor remarks on this bill shortly before the vote; he said he would vote no and the roll call records him voting no. His full remarks, including his questioning of the sponsor, are in the transcript.
